payload.description_html:
Atractosteus tropicus - microCT visualisation of bone mineral density in the skull of gar. Tissue density is mapped
in false color on a spectrum ranging from less dense (cool colors) to more dense (warm colors). This image was taken in Brian Metscher's lab.
